blocks.text: FOR NVIDIA. A BUSINESSWOMAN SUSPECTED OF SPYING FOR BEIJING, VERY CLOSE TO ITS CEO. AND AN AMERICAN PRESIDENT WHO WAS WARNED AND LOOKED THE OTHER WAY.
YOU'RE GOING TOO FAST, MY DEAR FELLOW. FIRST, HOW A FOREIGNER BECOMES A CHINESE LEADER'S MOST TRUSTED MAN. IT HAS HAPPENED HERE BEFORE. A HUNDRED YEARS AGO.
AN ENGLISHMAN WHO SHIPPED RIFLES TO CHINA IN SEWING-MACHINE CRATES.
HIS NAME WAS MORRIS COHEN. THEY CALLED HIM TWO-GUN. AND IT ALL BEGAN IN A POCKET.
